coreLanguage: Standard Python, not MakeCode Arcade Python

assets.title: Gaming Club mission
assets.alt: Four friendly voxel astronauts organise a gaming-club roster together. This is a fictional mission illustration, not the coding interface.

caption.en: Organise the players. Display the roster. Choose a captain.
caption.zh: 整理玩家名单，显示名单，再选出一位队长。
caption.ko: 플레이어 명단을 정리하고 표시한 뒤 주장을 선택하세요.

assets.title: What are we building?
assets.placement: Briefing and final Main Task 2 challenge
assets.alt: Expected console output with annotations for count, ordered player names and a possible random captain.

caption.en: Match the roster and count. Your captain may be a different listed player.
caption.zh: 名单和人数应相符；你的队长可以是名单中的另一位玩家。
caption.ko: 명단과 인원수를 맞추세요. 주장은 명단의 다른 플레이어일 수도 있습니다.

assets.title: Position is not the same as index
assets.placement: Do Now and Main Task 1 support
assets.alt: Three player slots with ordinal positions, zero-based indexes, length three and last index two.

caption.en: Position counts from first. Python indexes count from 0.
caption.zh: 位置从第一个开始数；Python 索引从 0 开始。
caption.ko: 순서는 첫 번째부터 세지만 Python 인덱스는 0부터 시작합니다.

assets.title: Replace, then append
assets.alt: A two-step before-and-after diagram distinguishes replacing an existing element from appending a new one.

caption.en: Replace changes an existing value. Append adds an element at the end.
caption.zh: 替换会改变已有的值；append 会在末尾添加一个元素。
caption.ko: 대입은 기존 값을 바꾸고 append는 끝에 원소를 추가합니다.

assets.title: Your real Game Club Python Lab
assets.alt: An authentic screenshot of this Game Club lab: type in the numbered code area, press Run and check, and read the console. The snacks example uses different data.

caption.en: Type in the numbered area, run, then read below. Use your task data, not this reference program.
caption.zh: 在编号代码区输入，运行，再阅读下方结果。使用任务数据，而非示例数据。
caption.ko: 줄 번호 옆에 입력하고 실행한 뒤 아래 결과를 읽으세요. 예시가 아닌 과제 데이터를 사용하세요.

assets.source: Actual local Game Club Python Lab, captured 27 October 2026

assets.title: Four jobs inside a list-reading loop
assets.alt: A Python while loop annotated to identify the start counter, boundary condition, indexed read and increment.

caption.en: Start at 0. Check the condition. Read one element. Move to the next index.
caption.zh: 从 0 开始，检查条件，读取一个元素，再移到下一个索引。
caption.ko: 0에서 시작해 조건을 확인하고 원소 하나를 읽은 뒤 다음 인덱스로 이동합니다.

assets.title: The counter walks through the roster
assets.alt: At counter 2, Pixel at index 2 is highlighted, the condition is true and the console has printed Nova, Luna and Pixel.

caption.en: One step reads one element. The output grows; the list does not change.
caption.zh: 每一步读取一个元素。输出逐行增加，但列表不变。
caption.ko: 한 단계에서 원소 하나를 읽습니다. 출력은 늘어나지만 리스트는 바뀌지 않습니다.

assets.title: Random does not mean a fixed answer
assets.alt: Four valid players, random.choice reference code and three example runs demonstrate valid results and possible repeats.

caption.en: Check that the captain is in the list. Repeated choices can still be correct.
caption.zh: 检查队长是否在列表中。重复选中同一个人仍可能是正确的。
caption.ko: 주장이 리스트에 있는지 확인하세요. 같은 사람이 반복 선택되어도 올바를 수 있습니다.

assets.title: Will it work with a different roster?
assets.alt: Three test cases with roster lengths 1, 3 and 5 and clear requirements for output and random selection.

caption.en: A general solution still works when the roster changes.
caption.zh: 名单改变后，通用的解决方法仍应正确运行。
caption.ko: 명단이 바뀌어도 일반적인 해결 방법은 올바르게 작동해야 합니다.

assets.title: Everyone gets a turn
assets.alt: An example four-round selection table shows each player chosen once as the remaining waiting list becomes empty.

caption.en: Remove the chosen player before choosing again. Stop when nobody is waiting.
caption.zh: 再次选择前，移除已选中的玩家。没有人等待时就停止。
caption.ko: 다시 선택하기 전에 뽑힌 플레이어를 제외하세요. 기다리는 사람이 없으면 멈춥니다.
